mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening labor market confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 consecutive instances of UNRATE declines, or correlation between UNRATE and returns < 0.3 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) crosses above 4.5%, it signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 instances of UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the threshold crossing is not preceded by a sustained weakening labor trend.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise, or the correlation between the two proxies and returns < 0.4 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) signals impending monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the relationship between CPIAUCSL declines and returns is weak (R-squared < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chains, reducing inflationary pressures and prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 50% of INDPRO upward trends, or the correlation between INDPRO and returns < 0.3 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) falls below 23000 billion chained 2017 dollars, it signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 drops below 23000 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 instances of GDPC1 drops below 23000, or the threshold crossing is not followed by a sustained contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and PAYEMS move in their respective favorable directions within the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies move favorably, or the interaction effect's t-statistic < 2.0 in 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary environment, a sustained rise in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 40% of recessionary periods, or the relationship between FEDFUNDS rises and returns is weak (R-squared < 0.1).
